```plato
    //==
    // # Boundary conditions as vectors
    //
    // Essential boundary conditions are applied by PROJECTION, not by editing the
    // matrix. A constrained degree of freedom is held at its prescribed value and
    // removed from the search space; the matrix is never modified, so it stays a
    // plain concatenation of element entries and can be assembled once and reused
    // under several sets of restraints.
    //
    // Both vectors below are built with a scatter rather than a search, so a
    // model with many constraints costs no more per constraint than one with few.

    // The projector onto the free degrees of freedom, as a per-degree-of-freedom
    // multiplier: 0 where the model prescribes a value and 1 everywhere else.
    // Projection is then `SystemProduct`, and a residual multiplied by it can no
    // longer move a restrained degree of freedom.
    FreeDofMultipliers(dofCount: Integer, constraints: Array<PrescribedDisplacement>): Array<Number>
    {
        var free = FilledNumbers(dofCount, 1.0);
        var k = 0;
        while (k < constraints.Count)
        {
            free = free.Set(constraints[k].Dof.Value, 0.0);
            k = k + 1;
        }
        return free.Freeze();
    }
```
